title: Input schema of the Patreon Tier Value Scraper

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Patreon creator pages to scrape (e.g., https://www.patreon.com/<creator>).

authMethod.title: Auth method
authMethod.description: Use 'credentials' to supply username/password for login (placeholder flow included).

username.title: Username / Email
username.description: Patreon account email/username for login (store secrets in env variables on Cloud).

password.title: Password
password.description: Patreon account password for login (store secrets in env variables on Cloud).

downloadImages.title: Download images
downloadImages.description: If true, download tier images to Key-Value store under images/<creatorSlug>/
